The test failure is an environment issue (missing Playwright browser binaries), unrelated to this change. The JSON parses correctly.

I made the arcs red and doubled their width in `noodles-editor/src/examples/uk-commute/noodles.json`:

- Set `getSourceColor` and `getTargetColor` to `#ff0000ff` (red) directly on `/arc-layer`, and removed the now-unused edges from `/source-color` and `/target-color` into the arc layer (those two color nodes still feed the residence/workplace scatterplot layers, unchanged).
- Doubled `getWidth` from `80` to `160`.

Everything else (opacity, height, positions, other layers, basemap, viewport) is untouched.
